subject: Workplace Skills
title: Feedback as a Mirror
description: A short lesson to help you apply Feedback as a Mirror.

hook.text: She thought she was great at presenting. Her 360 review said otherwise. The gap between self-image and reality hurt.

buildup.text: Self-assessment has a blind spot: you can't see what others see. External feedback fills in the picture.

discovery.text: Ask five trusted colleagues: 'What do I do best? Where do I need growth?' The patterns reveal your real brand.

twist.text: People sugarcoat feedback unless you make it safe. Ask specific questions: 'What's one thing I should stop doing?'

climax.text: Combine your self-view with external input. Where they align, you have clarity. Where they diverge, explore.

punchline.text: Ask what others see. Your view alone is incomplete.

quiz.question: Why is external feedback essential for self-assessment?
options: You can't see what others see; external feedback fills blind spots
